WHO WE ARE

Founded in 2015 by three veterans of the video game industry, Breaking Walls is an independent game studio with a clear purpose: to disrupt the norm, rebuild what is possible, and rethink how games move us.
At Breaking Walls, technology is not just a tool. It is a creative engine. We harness cutting-edge systems to reinvent how stories are told and how emotion is experienced through gameplay.

Our team brings decades of experience from AAA franchises like Assassin’s Creed, Prince of Persia, and Far Cry. In 2021, we launched our debut title AWAY: The Survival Series, a nature-inspired adventure that reimagined the documentary format through an interactive lens.

We are now building on that foundation with a diverse lineup of projects, including Venus: The Last Ascent, a physics-based construction adventure set in a sci-fi universe. Through BW Labs, our experimental R&D initiative, we are also developing new prototypes, technologies, and gameplay models that push the boundaries of design, simulation, and storytelling.
From deeply emotional experiences to playful systemic sandboxes, we are shaping the future of interactive entertainment one breakthrough at a time.

Technical Support
THE GAME CRASHES AS SOON AS I OPENED IT:
THE GAME CRASHES AS SOON AS I OPENED IT:
Don't panic! 99.99% of the time, this is easily fixed by updating your computer's graphics card drivers. Steam has created an easy to follow guide on how to do this here.
MY SCREEN HAS TURNED BLACK:
MY SCREEN HAS TURNED BLACK:
This is commonly caused by third-party overlays. The most common one is Raptr card overlay, you can find information on how to disable it here.
I’VE TRIED EVERYTHING AND IT STILL WONT RUN:
I’VE TRIED EVERYTHING AND IT STILL WONT RUN:
We are here to help! Send us the files we need and we'll do everything we can to help solve the problem. Make sure to describe the issue in as much detail as possible.
Collect two files from the locations below and email them to support@breakingwalls.co:
Find the DxDiag File:
Press "Windows Key + R" together.
Type "DxDiag" and press "Enter" to run the DirectX diagnostic tool.
Click "Save All Information" and save the file somewhere, then attach it to your email.
Find the "output_log.txt": Copy and paste the following path into file explorer: %AppData%..\Local\Away\Saved\Logs
I'D LIKE TO REPORT A BUG:
I'D LIKE TO REPORT A BUG:

A STORM IS COMING…
Set in a distant future, a series of natural disasters threaten the survival of every species on the planet. As you venture deeper into the wilderness, do you have what it takes to make it out alive?

AWAY follows the story of a young sugar glider on a journey to save his family. Your adventures will take you across vast environments as you discover a vibrant world brimming with life. But beware of the dangers that lie ahead...
PLAY YOUR OWN NATURE DOCUMENTARY
Glide among the trees, fight dangerous predators, and explore beautiful environments through the eyes of a sugar glider — all while a narrator describes your every move.

The Sugar Glider Time Trial Challenge
<time datetime="2025-06-17">Jun 17, 2025</time> · Written by Laurent Bernier
The Sugar Glider Time Trial Challenge
What it is, how it came to be, and how you can try that free game now!
Each game goes through multiple iterations and versions as they get conceived, and AWAY: The Survival Series is no different.
Did you know that, at some point, AWAY was supposed to be a VR game where you controlled the bearded vulture that ended up being the game's main antagonist?
After considering switching to a flying squirrel, we decided on a sugar glider, thinking this choice would showcase how AWAY's changing world was devastated by climate change.
Let’s get started!
HOW IT CAME TO BE
While developing AWAY's, we created this demo to showcase the gliding mechanic. It was recently retrieved from our vault, and we decided to give it a look to see how it was holding up.
It's only a little while later, as we were gripping our controllers and keyboards, trying to complete it as fast and efficiently as we could, we realized: this was still so much fun. And challenging.
So, after a bit of tweaking to make it into the time trial challenge it was always meant to be, we've released it for all of you, as a fun little present!
HOW TO GET IT
To get this free game, you just need to hop on this link here, join our Patreon (for free of course) and click on the link to install The Sugar Glider Time Trial Challenge.
THE GAMEPLAY
It's very simple: our sugar glider joey is famished. He wants to eat that dragonfly and is very motivated. The Terminator should take lessons from our joey. Really.
The sugar glider losing the dragonfly’s trail? Impossible. Of course, that handy yellow line helps a lot.

So you simply begin the game by pressing A or the Space bar to jump up and start gliding. Using the joystick or the arrows, you control the flight of the little marsupial, dodging obstacles as best as you can. Be careful, because any close encounter, whether with a tree, a rock, or a bear, will not end well for your sugar glider!
Flying through the air bubbles makes the sugar glider go faster!

There are three paths that get gradually harder, and you need to finish them as quickly as possible. If you catch the dragonfly, you get directly to the next level; who even needs to win a race if you get to eat your unfortunate opponent?
Once you reach the end of the very last, Hell level (verify term) path, you will get your score! And now quickly! Take a screenshot and share it on social media. Compare it to other players!
Can you beat this? Show us what you're made of!

Want to try it yourself?
The game is available for free on our Patreon. So don’t wait and click the link here to get it! And if you’re up to it, take a screenshot of your high score. Then post your results on your preferred social media, and don't forget to tag us!

SENTINEL: STONES OF DISRUPTION
SHOOT’EM UP

Sentinel: Stones of Disruption is an action-packed roguelike shoot'em up, featuring fast-paced combat, procedurally generated levels, and a variety of weapons and power-ups to discover. With stunning visuals, a gripping storyline, and challenging gameplay, Sentinel: Stones of Disruption is a must-play for fans of the genre.
PROVOKE CHAIN REACTIONS
Will you be able to navigate the dangerous terrain, defeat the golems, and recover the lost crystal, or will you succumb to the perils of the planet? The fate of the mission rests in your hands !
ELIMINATE HORDES

In Sentinel: Stones of Disruption, players take on the role of a highly advanced robot sent on a reconnaissance mission to a distant planet where a valuable crystal has been lost. However, upon arrival, they find themselves under attack by powerful rock golems who are determined to protect the magical crystal, which is crucial to their survival.
UPGRADE YOUR WEAPONRY

Players must use all their skills and weapons to fight off these formidable enemies and recover the lost crystal, while navigating treacherous environments filled with hazards and traps. Maximize your score by destroying everything that comes in your way !
Sentinel offers a fast paced style game-play that pushes you to think and react quick if you are to survive the hordes of enemies on your path.
After each horde, upgrade your weaponry & skill set using the tokens you’ve earned along the way.
Eliminate the numerous groups of creatures to face the final horde !

Short Description
Fold & Fly is a relaxing yet challenging game where you guide a paper plane through dreamy cardboard worlds, threading narrow gaps, catching wind currents, and chasing high scores.

FEATURES

✦ Intuitive, smooth flying gameplay with paper plane physics
✦ Infinite procedurally generated worlds to explore
✦ Score-chasing action: collect stars and chain near-misses
✦ Glowing origami dragonflies that summon portals to new worlds
✦ A whimsical, handcrafted art style
✦ Easy to pick up, satisfying to master
✦ Great for quick sessions or long flow-state flights

Breaking Walls Privacy Policy

At Breaking Walls, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how we handle personal information in relation to our video game, which is distributed on various gaming platforms, including Steam, PlayStation Network, Xbox Live, Epic Games Store, and other platforms as they become available (collectively, "Platforms").
1. Information We Collect

Through Our Video Game: We do not collect, store, or have access to any personal information from players directly through our video game. The game does not communicate with us or transmit any user data to our servers.
Through Our Website and Social Media: The only personal information we may receive is if you voluntarily provide it to us, such as when you:
Register on our website for a mailing list (e.g., providing your email address).
Follow us or interact with us on social media platforms (e.g., your public profile information, depending on your privacy settings on those platforms).
2. How We Use Information
We Do Not Use Information from the Game: We do not use any information collected from our video game for tracking, advertising, or any other purposes.

Mailing List: If you register for our mailing list, we will use your email address to send you information about our company, products, or services, such as news about new releases, updates, or special offers. You can unsubscribe from our mailing list at any time.
Social Media: We use social media to engage with our players and build our community. We may use information you publicly share on social media to respond to your comments or questions.
3. Third-Party Services

Gaming Platforms: Our video game may include features provided by the Platforms, such as trophies, achievements, or online leaderboards. These features are subject to the Platforms' own privacy policies, and we do not have access to or control over any personal information collected by them.
Other Third Parties: We do not share, sell, or rent your personal information to any other third parties, except as required by law or to comply with a legal process.
4. Data Security

We take reasonable measures to protect the security of any personal information you provide to us through our website or social media channels, including using appropriate technical and organizational safeguards. However, no method of transmission over the internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
5. Children's Privacy

Our video game is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child under 13 has provided us with personal information, please contact us, and we will take steps to delete such information.
6. Your Privacy Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information that we hold. You may also have the right to object to or restrict certain processing of your personal information. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.
7. Changes to this Privacy Policy

We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Any changes will be effective immediately upon posting the revised policy on our website. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any updates or changes.
8. Contact Us
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at info@breakingwalls.co.
By playing our video game or interacting with us through our website or social media, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.

BUILD YOUR ADVENTURE

Venus: The Last Ascent is a survival base-building adventure set on the hostile surface of Venus. Humanity's last hope lies above the clouds in Cloud City, a distant sanctuary that can only be reached by crossing one of the most dangerous worlds in the solar system.

Build and expand a massive fortress on wheels, turning your base into a self-sustaining mobile stronghold. Mine valuable resources, manage power, manufacture equipment, and defend your reactors against relentless robotic threats and the planet's unforgiving environment.

Customize your fortress with advanced machinery, automated systems, and powerful defenses. Explore a vast and deadly landscape, uncover lost technologies, and make strategic decisions that will determine whether your expedition survives the journey.

Combining physics-driven construction, exploration, automation, and survival gameplay, Venus: The Last Ascent challenges players to adapt, innovate, and keep moving toward humanity's final destination in the skies.
